999 Ride

Salt Lake City, UT · 9th and 9th · Social · Cruiser

999 Ride is a social and cruiser group ride in Salt Lake City, UT. It rolls every Thursday at 9:00 pm from 9th and 9th.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the 999 Ride group ride

Salt Lake's largest social ride: hundreds, sometimes over a thousand, meet at the corner of 900 South and 900 East every Thursday at 9. No gas engines, lights required. Leaderless and all-inclusive by design.
